title: Nashville SC chases record while Austin FC fights to survive
seoTitle: Nashville SC chases MLS record while Austin FC fights
subtitle: The clash between the teams marks the final stretch of the MLS season
excerpt: Eastern Conference leaders Nashville SC try to break Inter Miami's points record and secure the Shield, while Austin FC fights to stay in the race.
author: Daniele Morais
sourceName: MLSsoccer.com, The Austin Chronicle, FOX Sports
contentHtml:
Nashville SC has reached 60 points in 27 matches, leading the Eastern Conference and maintaining a 10-point advantage over the next club. The team, which has already clinched a berth in the Audi 2026 MLS Cup playoffs, is on track to break Inter Miami CF's 74-point record, with the goal of reaching 75 points in their final seven games.

Nashville chases points record

With seven games remaining, the Coyotes need 15 points to reach 75 points, equivalent to an average of 2.14 points per match. So far, the team already averages 2.22 points per game, putting them in position to set the 75-point record and leave their mark on MLS history.

Austin FC tries to escape the elimination zone

Attention turns to Austin FC, sitting in 13th place in the Western Conference, five points outside the playoff zone. Since August 19, the club has not lost more than eight consecutive games, but only three were wins, resulting in five draws. Interim head coach Davy Arnaud's focus is keeping the team in the hunt for a berth.

Decisive showdown in Austin

The match between Nashville and Austin is scheduled for Saturday at 8:30 PM. Nashville enters on the heels of two consecutive clean-sheet losses, while Austin holds a season record of 35 goals scored and 47 conceded, with a minus-12 goal differential. Nashville, on the other hand, has 22 wins, 2 draws, and 6 losses, with 6.6 goals scored per game and 2.7 conceded.

Recent team performance

Nashville has 22 wins, 2 draws, and 6 losses in their last 30 matches, averaging 6.6 goals scored and 19.5 corner kicks per game. Austin, across 30 games, has recorded 13 wins, 3 draws, and 14 losses, averaging 3.9 goals scored and 14.1 corner kicks per game.

Standout players

For Nashville, Sam Surridge has scored 16 goals and provided 2 assists, while Hany Mukhtar has 7 goals in his last 10 games. For Austin, Christian Ramirez has scored 9 goals and provided 2 assists this season.

Expectations for the game

With Nashville leading the Eastern Conference and chasing the Shield title, and Austin fighting to stay in the playoff race, the duel promises to be decisive for both teams. Nashville, boasting the points advantage and the league's best defense, enters as the favorite, but Austin has a chance to pull off an upset, especially if they can win the home matchup.

With information from MLSsoccer.com, The Austin Chronicle, FOX Sports.
